name: Shirayuki Yumina
source:
She is a shy and quiet girl.

Her cuteness is like a small animal and is especially popular among senior students.

She has severe androphoia.
She is worried about what she would do after graduating from Magnolia Girls' Academy. 'A wonderful love...' is what she has been yearning for as a young maiden.

The protagonist sympathises with Yumina because their circumstances are a little similar. Of course, Yumina does not know that fact because she only recognises the protagonist as a 'lovely-oneesama.'

[Translated from [url=https://www.moon-stone.jp/product/ms20/chara.html#yumina]official website[/url]]
